description: This file implements the LWM2M Firmware Object for Zephyr OS, including resource definitions, state management, callbacks, and object instantiation for firmware updates.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_state_inst
methods.description: Returns the update state for a specific firmware object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_state
methods.description: Returns the update state for the default (first) firmware object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_state_inst
methods.description: Sets the update state for a specific firmware object instance, updating the resource accordingly.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_state
methods.description: Sets the update state for the default firmware object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_result_inst
methods.description: Returns the update result for a specific firmware object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_result
methods.description: Returns the update result for the default firmware object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_result_inst
methods.description: Sets the update result for a specific firmware object instance, updating the resource and state accordingly.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_result
methods.description: Sets the update result for the default firmware object instance.

methods.name: package_write_cb
methods.description: Callback for writing firmware package data, manages state transitions and invokes user callbacks.

methods.name: package_uri_write_cb
methods.description: Callback for writing firmware package URI, initiates transfer if supported.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_write_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback for writing firmware package data.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_write_cb
methods.description: Gets the current callback for writing firmware package data.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback for firmware update execution.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_cb
methods.description: Gets the current callback for firmware update execution.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_cancel_cb
methods.description: Sets the callback for canceling firmware transfer.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_cancel_cb
methods.description: Gets the current callback for canceling firmware transfer.

methods.name: firmware_update_cb
methods.description: Callback to trigger firmware update process when resource is executed.

methods.name: firmware_create
methods.description: Creates a new firmware object instance, initializing resources and default values.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_init
methods.description: Initializes the firmware object, registers it, and creates default instances.
